preimage_policy: Each target must still exactly match its current SHA when applied by 162, else re-evaluate deltas; never reset/rebase/force.

proposed_behavior.source_of_identity: host-context state.identity via stable identity() object; no caller-controlled hostId
proposed_behavior.source_of_permission: product-authority resolve(original Request) and per-surface original roleMap/legacy nav; no role bootstrap
proposed_behavior.source_of_auth_mode: local/entry configured operator vs Microsoft identity only
proposed_behavior.source_of_session: identity.person(original Request) boolean only for 401 vs 403, never serialized
proposed_behavior.source_of_stamp: original product authority digest principalRef/policyVersion/accessRevision from resolve()
proposed_behavior.source_of_pages: original dashboardPages/plannerKeys/procurementKeys, source page manifest mapping, no artificial action enablement
proposed_behavior.source_availability: ctx.context direct success only; rest unavailable until separately attested live operational callbacks, to be installed by 162 with real producers
proposed_behavior.strictness: factory rejects original request drift, runtime instance/host mismatch, revoked principal/policy/accessRevision, late operation readiness and forged pages/ops
proposed_behavior.host_mount: existing native context handler already wired in the original local entry, no new HTTP listener
needs_after_patch: readOperations genuine per-operation operational probes (none provided by current host source)
